method: eaos audit . --out <dir> --skip site, then acting on the moves it ranked highest

closed.finding: seventeen test classes carried the same tearDownClass body
twelve test classes carried the same setUp/tearDown pair
five more test classes still carried their own setUp/tearDown pair
closed.action: the same canonical home; one class that owns a class-scoped lifetime is allowed and named

accepted.finding: six limitation tests share a shape: each asserts that one extractor declares its own limits
accepted.reason: They are one assertion per extractor, and the whole point is that each extractor states its own. Folding them into one parameterised test would remove the per-extractor guarantee to remove a resemblance. P1 asks for one definition per concept, not for zero repetition.
Measured, not closed. The redundancy detector reports observations, and turning each into a change needs a reading this loop did not do. Recorded as open rather than silenced.

accepted.finding: the AST check for returning copies matched its own source text at first
accepted.reason: Rewritten to parse rather than grep. Recorded because a checker that matches its own text is the same defect class the probe layer already guards against, and it reappeared in a test rather than in the product.

limits: Improving an indicator is evidence the move did what the simulator predicted, not that the codebase is better in any sense a reader would care about.
